notes: Most accuracy/sensitivity/specificity results (SNR sweeps, clause sweep 20-200 in Fig. 9, TM vs BNN in Figs. 24-25) exist only in figures. No dataset sizes or train/test proportions are given; p. 17 says 'the Breast Cancer training set has 300 data points for fixed threshold', which appears to confuse data points with the 300 Boolean features, so no train size was taken from it. Booleanization differs per experiment, so bits_per_feature, n_bins (Breast Cancer, Pima) and n_boolean_features are null and the values are in the description: Breast Cancer uses 10 bins in Sec. 5/Table 1 but 8 bins in Table 2; Pima uses 6 bins in Fig. 11 while Fig. 12 finds 8 optimal. Paper-internal inconsistency: Breast Cancer Qbin+Esp at -15 dB is 84 features in the Sec. 8 text (consistent with 33.6k parameters in Table 3 = 100x2x84x2) but 85 in Table 4; Parkinson's 20k parameters in Table 3 implies 50 features vs 49 in Table 4. The BNN architecture (300, 256, 2) is stated only for Breast Cancer with fixed thresholding; other BNNs are described as the 'configuration closest to the TM complexity'. Text on p. 9 points to 'Figure 1' for the 75.6% accuracy and the specificity/sensitivity comparison, apparently meaning Figure 7. Energy values in Table 4 are estimates, not measurements; implementation=asic refers to the source of the energy model, not to how the TMs were trained.
